# Which of your eBay items actually make money?

> Free eBay profit analyzer: drop in your Seller Hub Transaction report CSV and get a fee waterfall, profit per item, Promoted Listings, shipping-gap and refund findings. Runs in your browser, the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
